notes: Identity check: canonical text begins with OSF download yr64w and the title Behavioral Detection of Emotional, High-Stakes Deception: Replication in a Registered Report, names Leanne ten Brinke, Samantha Sprigings, Cameo Brown, Chloe Kam, and Hugues Delmas, and says Accepted for Publication in Law and Human Behavior. OSF project e2bpr and preregistration quy4w are identified on manuscript p. 2. This is a full accepted primary empirical manuscript with Methods, Results and tables, consistent with the supplied reference; the replication DOI, journal volume/pages and final publication year are not independently printed/verified in this candidate. No PDF path supplied. Both assigned rows have identical nonspecific descriptions, study 1, and locator p.7. Manuscript p.7 is background, not a coefficient table. No cue-specific target correspondence can be established. Do not map either audit ID by order. Candidate replication logistic coefficients in Table 4, manuscript p.33: upper face surprise beta weight (mean) –0.80, 95% CI [–3.35, 1.31]; lower face happiness 5.97 [0.30, 13.89]; tentative words 1.78 [0.26, 4.53]; word count –0.11 [–1.39, 1.35]. These are printed beta weights, not converted effects. Methods pp.13–14 explicitly z-score/standardize word count and tentative words; face predictors are presence/absence indicators, so a universally standardized-beta identity is not established. Table 4 reports CIs rather than numeric p values; p values from the correlation table concern different tests and cannot be paired with these coefficients. Candidate common replication model analytic N: 14 deceptive + 82 genuine = 96 pleader/video cases (mutually exclusive veracity groups), explicitly tied to the unbalanced replication analysis on p.15; 82 training and 14 test videos are also stated there and are analysis roles, not additional cases. Methods p.13 exclude cases if any of four behavioral cues cannot be coded; p.10 restricts to English direct appeals meeting ground-truth criteria and p.11 excludes circumstantial-evidence-only ground truth. The p.15 counts identify the model groups after these criteria; no additional exclusion count is given. Because row-specific target correspondence is unresolved, N remains a disposition candidate and is not promoted to a core positive field. Original and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
